{{quotation|[[Master Dungeon Guide]]|[[Outrunner Remlok|Remlok]], a lone Dwarven outrunner, waited near the entrance to a hidden sepulchre tucked away in the northern mountains. He wished to procure the [[Anvil of Dragrimmar]], a Dwarven artifact from a bygone age. The anvil was guarded by ancient traps and an ice elemental of immense size and power. Having this charismatic Dwarf on our side could only help our cause, so we braved the pitfalls and escorted him into the sepulchre. }}

==Notes==
*If you do not have the required quest, you cannot leave the first room due to the closed [[Gate of Strength|Gates of Strength]].
*For the [[Anything You Can Do]] quest, you must kill the [[Fragment of Antiquities]] on Level 1. However, there is a bug where killing the Remnants of Antiquity will sometimes also fulfill the quest requirement.
*One 'Proof' opens all corresponding gates.
*Completion of this dungeon will fill in page #7 of the [[Master Dungeon Guide]] [[storybook]].
